Name: Kenneth's Exotic Harvest
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Exotic Harvest[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]37 fruits, 5 veggies, and 20 saplings for Kenneth's Seed Shop, Kenneth's Fruit Shop, and Kenneth's Vegetable Shop. Plant the saplings, pick the fruits, and grab something exotic for your farm.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you get[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]37 fruits and 5 veggies, plus 20 saplings, all in Shop8.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]20 of the fruits also have matching saplings. Plant a sapling like a normal fruit tree, wait for its season, and pick the fruit when it is ready. Some trees fruit in spring, some in summer, and some in fall, so there is always something coming up. The rest of the fruits and veggies are sold on their own if you just want to grab some right away, and they are ready to eat or cook with.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Check Shop8 in game when you have time, and see what fits your farm.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Where to buy[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Seed Shop - Shop8 for saplings[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Fruit Shop - Shop8 for fruits[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Vegetable Shop - Shop8 for veggies[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]You buy with gold, no bars or gems needed.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Go to Kenneth's Seed Shop, Kenneth's Fruit Shop, or Kenneth's Vegetable Shop, Shop8.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Take a look at what is for sale.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Buy the sapling, fruit, or veggie you like. Plant the saplings, and use the fruits and veggies how you like. Shop only, no quests, no crafting.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What you need[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Stardew Valley 1.6[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• SMAPI[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Seed Shop - you need this so Shop8 shows up for saplings[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Fruit Shop - you need this so Shop8 shows up for fruits[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• Kenneth's Vegetable Shop - you need this so Shop8 shows up for veggies[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]• DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]How to install[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI and Content Patcher first.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Put this mod in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Make sure Kenneth's Seed Shop, Kenneth's Fruit Shop, and Kenneth's Vegetable Shop are also installed.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]4. Start the game and check Shop8.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with other mods?[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Yeah. Works with the other fruits, saplings, and veggies from Kenneth's shops. You can add it in the middle of a save, no need to start a new game.[/b][/size]
